name: failure_grounded
prompt:
This is the forward-facing camera view from a small indoor mobile robot driving across a room.

Telemetry at this moment:
- commanded forward speed: {cmd_linear_x} m/s
- commanded turn rate: {cmd_angular_z} rad/s
- distance actually travelled so far: {path_m} m
- time since the run started: {t_s} s

Using BOTH the image and the telemetry, is the robot in trouble?

Answer with these exact categories:
- "none": it is making normal progress
- "stuck": it is being commanded to move but is not moving
- "oscillation": it is moving but not getting anywhere
- "goal_unreachable": the way ahead is fully closed off

Respond as JSON: {"failed": true or false, "failure_mode": "one of the categories above", "reason": "one short sentence"}
